emotional_tone: Confident, precise, tactical, niche trader vibe

layout.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center

surfaces.input: bg-[#0D0D0D] border border-[#333333] rounded-none focus:border-yellow-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-500/50 text-white font-mono transition-colors
surfaces.terminal_card: bg-[#0D0D0D] border border-[#333333] p-8 rounded-none relative overflow-hidden

components.label: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-gray-400 block
components.breakdown_row: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-b border-[#333333]/50 last:border-0
components.profit_container: mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-[#333333] flex flex-col gap-2
components.margin_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-none text-xs font-mono border border-current

motion.number_ticker: Use framer-motion to animate number changes smoothly

assets.icons: lucide-react (ShoppingCart, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Percent, Box, Truck)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app focusing on the IT reseller use case.
Do NOT use generic rounded cards. Keep border-radius to 0 (rounded-none) for a tactile, technical terminal vibe.
Form inputs should be on the left (lg:col-span-7). Include: Nom de l'article, Date, Plateforme de revente (Select), Prix d'achat, Prix de vente, Frais de livraison (default 10).
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric inputs and outputs to give it a precise, financial tool look.
The right side (lg:col-span-5) is the 'Terminal' breakdown. Calculate automatically when inputs change.
Calculations: Leboncoin Tax = 5% of Prix d'achat. URSSAF = 13% of Prix de vente. Delivery = user input (default 10). Net Profit = Prix vente - Prix achat - LBC Tax - URSSAF - Delivery.
Show a clear breakdown list: Prix de vente, - Prix d'achat, - Taxe Leboncoin (5%), - Livraison, - URSSAF (13%). Then a massive NET PROFIT at the bottom.
Color-code the NET PROFIT: text-green-500 if > 0, text-red-500 if < 0. Provide a margin % badge next to it.
Add a subtle 'noise' or 'grain' texture over the background if possible, or keep it strictly clean matte black/charcoal.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (inputs, breakdown rows, net profit) for testing.
